name: clawd-agents
description: Clawd Agents — multi-chain autonomous crypto trading bot on Telegram

scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npx prisma db push --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && tsc -b
scripts.db:generate: prisma generate --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && printf 'CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS legacy; DO $$ BEGIN IF to_regclass(''public.management_bot_configs'') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE public.management_bot_configs SET SCHEMA legacy; END IF; IF to_regclass(''public.management_groups'') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE public.management_groups SET SCHEMA legacy; END IF; IF to_regclass(''public.management_schema_meta'') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE public.management_schema_meta SET SCHEMA legacy; END IF; IF to_regclass(''public.management_signals'') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE public.management_signals SET SCHEMA legacy; END IF; IF to_regclass(''public.management_users'') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE public.management_users SET SCHEMA legacy; END IF; IF to_regclass(''public.telegram_sessions'') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE public.telegram_sessions SET SCHEMA legacy; END IF; END $$;' | prisma db execute --stdin --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db push --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss
